Research interests span physical modelling, computation, experimentation, and engineering design.

## Acoustics and vibroacoustics

- Acoustic wave propagation, noise generation and control
- Vibroacoustic modelling and measurements
- Acoustics of rail and infrastructure systems

## Dynamics, stability, and inverse problems

- Modelling of dynamical systems and stability
- Signal processing and inverse methods
- Robust parameter inference from experimental observations

## Systems engineering and innovation

- Multidisciplinary design and optimization
- Simulation, prototyping, experimental validation
- Reproducible computational workflows
